BiblicalUsage: Service in the temple is the work of vessels and ministry. The instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, are carried in blue cloth, and the money left over from repairing the house is made into vessels to minister and to offer withal. The word is the service itself, and the things that serve it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ministry is carried in the vessels as much as in the voices, for the instruments had to be covered and carried with care, and I hold that God notices how His servants handle holy things.
